title: Fast Fusion
subtitle: A new machine from two familiar ones
summary: Fast Fusion is Shin'en Multimedia's futuristic racing game, released with Nintendo Switch 2 on 5 June 2025.
body: Fast Fusion is Shin'en Multimedia's futuristic racing game, released with Nintendo Switch 2 on 5 June 2025. The fourth Fast game continues the series' high-speed anti-gravity racing and colour-based phase switching. Its new fusion system combines vehicles into different machines, giving the player another way to shape a racing approach. Races reward placement with coins that purchase further cups, vehicles and combinations, linking performance on the circuit to the range of machines available for the next attempt.

Coloured boost strips and jump pads require a matching vehicle phase. Changing colour at the right moment helps maintain speed and reach the intended route, while poorly timed switches interrupt that flow. Tracks demand attention to both the next bend and the coloured sections approaching it. Fusing two vehicles changes the machine brought to those situations, encouraging experiments with combinations rather than treating each unlocked craft as a fixed alternative. The race becomes the place where the practical difference between those choices can be felt.

Local split-screen supports up to four players. Super Hero Mode increases the risk by using boost energy as health, forcing acceleration and survival to draw on the same reserve. Different performance options allow the presentation to balance resolution and visual detail, with support for HDR. Bjulin and Francisco Cerda contributed the music. Fast Fusion develops the series through its new hardware while keeping the central demand immediate: recognise the next piece of track, match its phase and preserve enough control to make the following decision.
